name: Mushrooms For Winter Use
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: quarter of a pound of butter
ingredients.originalText: one quarter of a pound of butter

instructions.text: Wash and wipe free from grit the small fresh button mushrooms
Put into a frying pan a quarter of a pound of the very best butter
Add to it two whole cloves, a saltspoonful of salt and a tablespoonful of lemon juice
When hot add a quart of the small mushrooms
Toss them about in the butter for a moment only
Fill the top of each jar with an inch or two of the butter and let it cool
Keep the jars in a cool place
When the butter is quite firm add a top layer of salt

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash and wipe free from grit the small fresh button mushrooms
2. Put into a frying pan a quarter of a pound of the very best butter
3. Add to it two whole cloves, a saltspoonful of salt and a tablespoonful of lemon juice
4. When hot add a quart of the small mushrooms
5. Toss them about in the butter for a moment only
6. Put them in jars
7. Fill the top of each jar with an inch or two of the butter and let it cool
8. Keep the jars in a cool place
9. When the butter is quite firm add a top layer of salt
10. Cover to keep out dust
